# Errors and FAQ

If an error occurs, system returns error message with status code 400

## Error Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string"
  }
}
```

> [Error codes here](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/subscribe.html#error-codes)

## Notes (extraction)
- The “Error codes here” link targets relative `subscribe.html#error-codes`, resolved against this page to `/subscribe/service-payment/subscribe.html#error-codes`; this does not match the sidebar error-codes page. EN, RU and UZ agree on status 400 and the error response; each locale uses the equivalent relative link under its own locale path.
